day_shape: 58 items in a post-war frame: Kushner-Blair-Mladenov shuttle between Cairo Hamas talks and Netanyahu, IDF strikes two Gaza operatives, Iran advances 'foreign infiltration' bill and weighs gasoline rationing, US mulls tougher China-linked sanctions.

threads.label: Kushner-Blair-Mladenov Gaza shuttle
threads.summary: Jared Kushner, Tony Blair and Gaza Board of Peace head Nikolay Mladenov met a Hamas delegation in Cairo and are set to meet Netanyahu to push Trump's 20-point plan. Arab and Islamic foreign ministries condemned Israel's rejection of the Board's 15-point roadmap.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and coordination assessment
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck two operatives in Khan Younis and Nuseirat within an hour, with Palestinian media reporting injuries at a tent and in Nuseirat. The IDF also assessed that Hamas and Hezbollah have begun coordinating increased activity with Iranian assistance.

threads.label: US sanctions push and Hormuz shipping
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported the US is weighing tougher Iran sanctions targeting Chinese banks and oil buyers, naming Hengli Group — a $100bn+ Chinese firm — as a primary Iranian crude importer. Shipping in the Strait of Hormuz slowed following Iranian attacks on Gulf vessels.

threads.label: Iran domestic crackdown and fuel strain
threads.summary: Iran's parliament approved general principles of a bill criminalising contact with foreign media and embassies, and executed a man convicted over January's Karaj protests, with Iran International reporting a Bushehr MP personally fired at protesters. The government is weighing three gasoline-rationing proposals as war damage widens the fuel deficit.

threads.label: Iran post-war posture and regime messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office announced fortieth-day commemorations for 'Iran's martyr' in Tehran, Qom and Mashhad, while Defa Press quoted the IRGC deputy political officer saying defensive actions 'could also become offensive'. The Jerusalem Post reported Army commander Amir Hatami announced a $30,000 reward for captured or killed US service members, and Iran demanded Qatar access to investigate pilots it says were captured.

events.summary_en: The naval missile recovery system called TRAM, named after America's criminal president, was unable to help the American terrorist army in the regional war against Iran. American military officials have announced that this system will reach operational readiness by 2027. Without doubt, the readiness of this system in 2027 will be an example of a cure after death, and will provide no assistance to America's failed and wounded navy. The TRAM system is essentially a set of equipment, comprising a crane truck and a pair of rails that enables the recovery of missile launch systems in open water.

events.title_en: Russia tests floating platform Plot-40; a small floating gun emplacement (approximately 4.5 by 2.5 metres) on four floats resembling a pillbox; mounted on it is a remotely operated machine-gun module, presumably 12.7-millimetre or a 20-millimetre cannon, to protect naval bases, ports and coastal infrastructure against Ukrainian unmanned surface drones. This system is fixed or semi-fixed, has no engine and must be towed. It can remain at sea for long periods and both monitor and fire. It is not yet clear whether it is fully automatic or requires a crew. Its prototype has been built in the Leningrad region, has received initial Navy approval, and its production will be indigenous...

events.summary: از سوی رهبر معظم انقلاب برگزار می‌شود 📢 مراسم بزرگداشت چهلم «آقای شهید ایران» در تهران، قم و مشهد 🗒 دفتر رهبر انقلاب اسلامی به مناسبت چهلمین روز تشییع و تدفین پیکر آقای شهید ایران، با صدور اطلاعیه‌ای از برگزاری مراسم بزرگداشت رهبر شهید حضرت آیت‌الله‌العظمی سیّدعلی حسینی خامنه‌ای در تهران، قم و مشهد خبر داد. متن کامل اطلاعیه دفتر رهبر انقلاب اسلامی: 🏴 بسمه‌تعالی ▪️ هم‌زمان با ایام چهلمین روز تشییع تاریخی و تدفین پیکر مطهر آقای شهید ایران، مراسم بزرگداشت آن رهبر عظیم‌الشأن و خانواده ایشان از سوی حضرت آیت‌الله سیّدمجتبی حسینی خامنه‌ای، رهبر معظم انقلاب اسلامی، در تهران، قم و مشهد برگزار می‌شود. ▪
events.title_en: Commemoration of the fortieth day of 'Iran's martyr' held by the Supreme Leader in Tehran, Qom and Mashhad
events.summary_en: The office of the Supreme Leader announced in a statement the holding of a commemoration of the martyr leader, Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Hosseini Khamenei, on the occasion of the fortieth day of the funeral and burial of 'Iran's martyr', in Tehran, Qom and Mashhad. Full text of the Supreme Leader's office statement: In the Name of God. Coinciding with the fortieth day of the historic funeral and burial of 'Iran's martyr', a commemoration of that great leader and his family will be held by His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution, in Tehran, Qom and Mashhad.
